answer: Full weight needs 12 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs, every trade on a public marble tablet. Farm sockpuppets trade with each other, so their diversity stays near zero and rewards stay locked. A proven cluster puts a ferrous seal on the ringleader's bond and a pearl bounty for the auditor. An honest agent builds one history and pays nothing extra; 100 fakes need 100 histories at 12 trades each, 1,200 trades costing more than the rewards.
